description:
# 1.1.0

## The Android TV source from 1.2.0

From 1.2.0, this is the only source for the Android TV patches. The phone source, mobile-morphe-patches, includes them for the last time in its 1.1.0 release.

## New apps

- **ESPN** 6.13.2: Skip ads (experimental), Hide rating prompt, Block analytics and tracking, Hide device identifiers, Disable auto-updates.
- **Fox One** 1.20.0: Disable Pairip license check, Skip ads (experimental), Hide rating prompt, Block analytics and tracking, Hide device identifiers, Disable auto-updates.
- **Hulu** C59F39CFP3.10.33 (experimental): Skip ads, which removes the ads Hulu stitches into on-demand shows, and Block analytics and tracking (off by default).
- **MGM+** 241.0.2026241001: Skip lion intro, Hide rating prompt, Disable MGM+ AI, Block analytics and tracking, Hide device identifiers, Disable auto-updates.
- **MLB** 26.21.0.76: Skip ads, Translate ad break screen (experimental), Hide rating prompt, Hide betting odds, Mask live ad breaks (experimental), Block analytics and tracking, Hide device identifiers, Disable auto-updates.
- **NBA** 1.1.0.20261026155843: Skip ads (experimental), Reject tracking consent, Hide rating prompt, Block analytics and tracking, Hide device identifiers, Disable auto-updates.
- **NFL** 18.27.0: Skip ads (experimental), Reject tracking consent, Hide rating prompt, Block analytics and tracking, Hide device identifiers, Disable auto-updates.
- **PBS** 5.27.0 and **Peacock** 7.10.200: Skip ads (experimental), Hide rating prompt, Block analytics and tracking, Hide device identifiers, Disable auto-updates.
- **Prime Video** 6.24.13: Skip ads (experimental), Force highest quality (experimental, off by default).
- **YouTube TV** (the official app, 4.01.03): Skip ads (experimental). This app needs Android 12 or later.

Optional patches are off by default: Block analytics and tracking, Hide device identifiers, Disable auto-updates, Disable MGM+ AI, Hide betting odds, and Mask live ad breaks.

## Changes

- **YouTube for Android TV**: Skip injected ads is now **YT TV+ (ad-free YouTube TV)**, a clearer name for the patch that turns it into a standalone, ad-free YouTube TV app. It now refuses an input without its native libraries, which made the patched app close on launch.
- **Apple TV** and **NewsNation**: the patches no longer end in "(Android TV)", since every app in this source is an Android TV app. Morphe Manager treats a renamed patch as new, so check your selections for these apps.
- **Pluto TV**: adds Translate ad break screen (experimental), which shows the "We'll be right back!" screen in your device's language.
- **Hide device identifiers** now holds Spoof carrier, Report Wi-Fi connection, and Hide VPN connection as options, so each app lists one privacy entry. If you used any of the old patches, turn on the matching option in Hide device identifiers.
- **Block analytics and tracking** now also blocks the domains of the malware that compromised Optimizely website scripts on 16 November 2026.
- **Experimental versions**: every app version that is public on Google Play is a standard target. Hulu and the official YouTube TV app 4.01.03 stay experimental.

## Version support

Newly supported versions, with the previous versions kept:

- JustWatch 26.44.5
- NewsNation 4.71
- Pluto TV 17.4.0
- Starz 6.12.1 and 6.11.0
